read.thesis: Teva Q1 revenue flat in USD and down 3% LC on lenalidomide erosion, but innovative brands grew 41% LC to $838M; non-GAAP EPS $0.53 with guidance held (ex-Emalex) and FCF $188M.

triggers.label: Innovative brands +41% LC to $838M
triggers.quote: AUSTEDO, AJOVY, and UZEDY revenues collectively grew by 41% YoY in LC to $838 million
triggers.highlight: grew by 41% YoY in LC to $838 million

triggers.label: US generic revenue down 28%
triggers.quote: lower revenues from lenalidomide capsules (the generic version of Revlimid®) due to increased generic competition in the U.S.
triggers.highlight: due to increased generic competition in the U.S.

triggers.label: Non-GAAP op margin 24.0% vs 24.3%
triggers.quote: The decrease in non-GAAP operating margin in the first quarter of 2026 was due to higher S&M expenses as a percentage of revenues
triggers.highlight: due to higher S&M expenses as a percentage of revenues

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow negative
red_flags.quote: Cash flow used in operating activities of $40 million

red_flags.label: Leverage 67% and short-term debt rising to 16%
red_flags.quote: The portion of total debt classified as short-term as of March 31, 2026 was 16% compared to 11% as of December 31, 2025.
